mapper.sql: id, ledger_book_id, chart_account_id, owner_type, owner_id, balance_bucket, normal_side, account_status, create_time, update_time

SELECT l.account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN l.entry_side = 'DEBIT' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) debit_total, SUM(CASE WHEN l.entry_side = 'CREDIT' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) credit_total, MAX(e.journal_sequence) last_journal_sequence FROM t_journal_line l JOIN t_journal_entry e ON e.id = l.journal_entry_id WHERE e.ledger_book_id = #{ledgerBookId} GROUP BY l.account_id

COALESCE(j.debit_total, 0) debit_total, COALESCE(j.credit_total, 0) credit_total, CASE WHEN a.normal_side = 'DEBIT' THEN COALESCE(j.debit_total, 0) - COALESCE(j.credit_total, 0) ELSE COALESCE(j.credit_total, 0) - COALESCE(j.debit_total, 0) END net_balance, COALESCE(j.last_journal_sequence, 0) last_journal_sequence
mapper.select: SELECT a.id account_id, c.account_code, a.owner_type, a.owner_id, a.balance_bucket, a.normal_side, a.account_status, FROM t_ledger_account a JOIN t_chart_account c ON c.id = a.chart_account_id LEFT JOIN () j ON j.account_id = a.id WHERE a.ledger_book_id = #{ledgerBookId} AND a.owner_type IN #{ownerType} ORDER BY c.account_code, a.owner_type, a.owner_id, a.balance_bucket, a.id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT a.id FROM t_ledger_account a JOIN t_journal_line l ON l.account_id = a.id WHERE a.owner_type IN #{ownerType} AND a.ledger_book_id IN #{id} GROUP BY a.id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN l.entry_side = 'DEBIT' THEN l.amount ELSE -l.amount END) <> 0 ) t

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.entry_side = 'DEBIT' THEN l.amount END), 0) debit_total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.entry_side = 'CREDIT' THEN l.amount END), 0) credit_total, COALESCE(MAX(e.journal_sequence), 0) last_journal_sequence FROM t_journal_line l JOIN t_journal_entry e ON e.id = l.journal_entry_id WHERE l.account_id = #{accountId}
